title: Provider numbers from the health cases in the federal clinician file
question: Which provider numbers named in the Health billing cases and medical screens are clinicians enrolled in Medicare in San Francisco, and with which group?
finding: Of 126 provider numbers named in Health billing cases and the medical screens, 3 appear as San Francisco clinicians in the October 2026 federal file. The rest are organizations (pharmacies, suppliers, clinics), which the clinician file does not list, or are not enrolled in Medicare in San Francisco. The file holds 152,910 California clinicians and 8,859 with a San Francisco practice address.
how: Provider numbers were collected from every case in the Health billing category and from the rows of the medicaid and medical_claims screens, then looked up in the Doctors and Clinicians national file (streamed from its gzipped copy; California rows kept). Rows are grouped by practice and address; individual clinicians are counted, not named.
limits: The clinician file lists only individuals enrolled in Medicare who bill under it; an organization, a pharmacy or a clinician who sees only Medi-Cal patients is not in it. Absence means nothing on its own.
